'''Imperial Security Bureau headquarters''' was a structure located in [[Capital City]] that served as the [[Imperial Security Bureau]]'s headquarters on the [[planet]] [[Lothal]]. A tall building, it overlooked [[Capital City spaceport]] and contained the office of ISB [[Lieutenant]] [[Jenkes]].<ref name="Ezra's Gamble" />
